scenes.narration: The Overview of Korea page covers the country's essentials. Here are three. First, geography: Korea sits on a peninsula about a thousand kilometers long, and roughly seventy-five percent of it is mountains. Second, it is a land of four distinct seasons, from spring cherry blossoms to snowy winters. Third, Hangeul, the Korean alphabet, was created in 1443 by King Sejong to make reading and writing accessible to everyone.
